text_blocks.snippet: Mega Venusaur ex is a prominent Stage 2 Grass-type Pokémon card from the Mega Evolution (MEG / ME01) expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.

list.snippet: HP: 380 HP (tied for one of the highest base HP stats of any tournament-legal card)
Ability — Solar Transfer: Move a Basic Grass Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon as often as you like during your turn.
Attack — Jungle Dump: Costs GGGG (4 Grass Energy) to deal 240 damage and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
Weakness / Resistance / Retreat: Fire weakness (Rx2), no resistance, and a retreat cost of 4.
Card Numbers: Standard Double Rare is #003/132, and the Special Illustration Rare version is #177/132 (illustrated by mashu).
Standard / Double Rare (#003/132): Typically trades around $1.00 to $5.00 USD raw, available through retailers like ToyWiz.com and Flipside Gaming.

Special Illustration Rare (#177/132): Ungraded market values hover around $120 to $130 USD, while graded copies (such as PSA 10) command roughly $210 to $350 USD on platforms like Fanatics and TCGplayer.
Official Products: Featured prominently in the Mega Venusaur ex Premium Collection.
